locator: Break Free From Plastic press release, 16 April 2024, methodology and key findings
summary: The audit involved 807 volunteers from 25 organisations, 50 locations in four Asian countries, 33,467 collected sachets and 2,678 recorded brands. The coalition lists Nestlé among the top ten companies identified in the collected single-use sachet waste.
limitations: Volunteer collection data is not a representative measure of all sachets sold or discarded. The public summary does not provide a Nestlé-specific item count.
